data.name: Nastaran
data.gender_notes: Nastaran is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Persian culture, Nastaran means 'treasure' or 'jewel'. It is derived from the Persian word 'nastan', which means 'to place, to store'. This name evokes images of something precious, valuable, and cherished. The name Nastaran carries the meaning “Jewel, treasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nastaran usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel, treasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Nastaran belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jewel, treasure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nastaran total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: نستران
in_arabic.meaning: نستران تعني الزهرة الجميلة او الوردة النادرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: نستران هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل غير عربي، وقد يكون مشتقا من الكلمة العربية 'نَسْتَر' والتي تعني الزهرة الجميلة أو الوردة النادرة. يستخدم هذا الاسم في بعض الثقافات الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الجمال والرقة.

in_urdu.name: نستران
in_urdu.meaning: نستران ایک خوبصورت اور نایاب پھول کی طرح ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: نستران ایک فارسی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت پھول یا نایاب گل۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے बीच مقبول ہے اور اکثر اس کا تعلق خوبصورتی اور رقت سے جوڑا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नस्तरान
in_hindi.meaning: नस्तरान का अर्थ है सुंदर और दुर्लभ फूल
in_hindi.long_meaning: नस्तरान एक नाम है जो भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रचलित है। इसका अर्थ है सुंदर और दुर्लभ फूल, जो अक्सर प्राकृतिक सौंदर्य और विशिष्टता का प्रतीक माना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: نستران
in_pashto.meaning: نستران د ښکلی ګل یا نادره ګل په مانا دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: نستران په پښتو کې د ښکلی ګل یا نادره ګل په مانا دی. دا نوم په افغانستان او پاکستان کې د پښتنو په منځ کې مشهور دی او ډیری وختونه د ښکلا او رقت سره تړاو لري.

It represents the idea of accumulating wealth, not just in the form of material possessions but also knowledge, wisdom, and spirituality. The name signifies the value of preserving and cherishing what is most precious, which is an essential aspect of both Persian and Islamic cultures.

It represents the idea that our true treasure lies within ourselves, in our inner beauty, wisdom, and enlightenment. Therefore, the name serves as a reminder for us to cultivate our spiritual selves and seek the treasure of knowledge, wisdom, and compassion.
